assessment_scope: Formal independent whole-package Design Review, round 1, against approved proposal-review for 2026-09-17-complete-model-test-coverage. Full reads cover all 24 registered living models; shared rules and navigation; all three complete Skill, Authoring and Release test-design packages; 56 current CLI/Records example files and the Workflow correction-cycle example. The 104 exact subjects capture these reviewed members and relied-on examples. Assessment covers all current numbered and section-owned obligations, parent interactions, requirement/scenario selection, credible semantic/executable observation boundaries, fixture intent, honest realization gaps, and feasible complete-inventory case duration reporting. It assesses Design coherence and acceptance intent; it does not certify implementation, execution of proposed semantic procedures, or completed proof.

findings.evidence: Severity: major. Finding scope: artifact-local. Affected artifact ID: skill. Owning stage: design. Locations: docs/design/skill/skill.md:5, :574, :662. The current introductory contract says customer feature-spec support remains; Complete skill-set refinement says retained feature amendments are output members; Living test-design method adoption explicitly requires preserving existing supported feature-format amendment methods and their conditional resources. These are operative consumer/adoption instructions, not solely historical provenance. They contradict the governing Design DES-SR-14/23/24, which withdraw feature/proof creation and amendment for repository and customer use while preserving source interpretation and separately authorized living-model adoption, and contradict AUTH-SH-005. Following Skill while implementing this test-design guidance could recreate retired output methods/resources and fail the required unsupported-output behavior.
findings.required_outcome: Align all surviving Skill summaries and test-design/refinement consumer prescriptions with the current Design source/output boundary. Retained sources remain readable authority with unchanged bytes; feature/proof and standalone architecture/ADR output remain unsupported; only separately authorized scoped adoption may reconcile them into living Designs. Safe resolution path: the Skill Design author edits these contradictory prescriptions and checks neighboring current guidance for the same implication, without restoring retired resources, changing the approved compatibility boundary, or editing historical judgments. Then independently reassess the exact corrected complete package. No new owner decision is needed because Design already defines the current boundary.

resolution.rationale: The finding reporter independently inspected current Skill sha256:9635574034989acca7995e8b1946516abeb66b2b94db7bcb758b3a3ecfb8bb22 and its complete correction diff against the CLI-confirmed original reviewed bytes sha256:4b30bb60678cca65c830833a6dba2195f585cfaabe921874c08afdbb0da1188c. Exactly the three reported operative prescriptions changed. Lines 5, 574 and 662 now consistently preserve readable source authority and historical identities, forbid feature/proof and standalone architecture/ADR output, and permit only separately authorized scoped adoption into living Designs; the adoption paragraph expressly prohibits restoring retired methods/resources. The neighboring design refinement treatment, governing DES-SR-14/23/24 and unchanged AUTH-SH-005 agree. This direct source/diff inspection proves the reported Design contradiction is removed; no runtime test is required to prove this textual contract correction. The independent complete-package reassessment is recorded separately as design-review-final. Original finding evidence, subjects and required outcome remain preserved.

limitations: This review establishes no executable-suite completion, fixture-alignment completion, timing measurement, implementation correctness, final Verify, branch readiness, PR readiness or publication authority. Proposed and partial proof remains subject to explicit reviewed delivery allocation and execution.

The delegated bounded assessment supports the CLI/Engineering portion only; the overall judgment is this reviewer's complete-package decision. Source corroboration and parseable examples do not prove all runtime invariants.

This review performed no runtime tests. Parent-reported structural, prose and CI results are supplemental author evidence and are not the basis for a semantic approval claim. No workflow activity or reviewed source was mutated by the reviewing runtimes.
rationale: Approved direction preserved: the package retains all four proposal outcomes: an explicit selection method; model-owned design for the complete current model inventory and parent responsibilities; required case/fixture alignment and gap closure in subsequent delivery; and attributable runtime through the existing native executor. No proposed gap is reclassified as completed or optional solely because the Design is saved.

Selection sufficiency: System TEST-SR-21 through TEST-SR-23 and the shared rules require every current supported obligation, distinct promised outcomes, plausible violations, consequence/exposure/recovery risk, meaningful partition/boundary/transition and authority/recovery variations, independent expected observations, and the smallest sufficient fixture and real boundary. The worked installation and authoring examples make selection actionable. A documented sufficiency decision, rather than a case count or largest Cartesian product, terminates selection.

Coverage and composition: every current document model identifies local groups, explicit requirement/responsibility coverage, representative success and failure observations, fixtures, realization locations and remaining gaps. Section-owned skills and parent interactions retain observations beyond the union of children. The three separate catalog packages retain identity and proposed/partial classifications; the added Skill handoff cases cover remaining distinct responsibilities without pretending structural checks prove actor judgment.

Proof honesty: structural validators and source assertions have bounded claims; semantic review procedures require concrete current packets, independently expected decisions and counterexamples. Packed, transaction, publication, authority and recovery boundaries remain with their real owners. Existing packed-install and broad-diagnostic gaps are expressly accounted for; Design approval need not pretend those future implementation slices have already executed.

Timing/reporting feasibility: Validation VAL-SR-36 through VAL-SR-38 and VAL-DEC-12 extend existing dispatch identities and result envelopes. The contract defines the complete supported caller union, native case identity, process/subtest accounting, worker duration versus wall time, unstarted/legacy results, comparable baselines, ranked reporting, explicit JSON output and safe atomic report publication. Required negative and interrupted-run observations are specified without creating a replacement runner, timing threshold, cache or live release authority.

Ownership and compatibility: shared test-selection policy stays with System, behavioral obligations with their models, operational timing with Validation and execution allocation with Plan. The current views, decisions, source-preservation boundaries and referenced examples are mutually coherent except for the identified Skill consumer contradiction. Existing-source authority does not restore withdrawn feature/proof output.

Material correction: finding skill-feature-output-boundary is artifact-local to skill at the Design authoring stage. Skill lines 5, 574 and 662 still say feature-spec support/amendment output methods remain, while Design DES-SR-14/23/24 and AUTH-SH-005 explicitly require unsupported-output behavior. This direct current adoption instruction can lead subsequent implementation to retain or recreate retired methods and makes package approval premature.

Judgment precedence: upstream proposal authority, full required basis and actual reviewer independence are present. A supported material correction therefore yields changes-requested, not blocked or inconclusive. Route owns returning the named correction to its author and obtaining a current exact-package reassessment.
summary: The complete test-design direction is coherently realized across all 24 model owners, shared selection rules, catalog packages and the Validation timing/reporting contract, except that Skill still directs preservation of retired feature-format output methods. Correct that surviving consumer contract before relying on this package for delivery planning.
